origin.description: The global option remotes.git_credentials is used to set the git credentials.
origin.details: install_git reads this option when credentials are not supplied. The option is global. An unset option is NULL.
origin.value: The value of remotes.git_credentials, or NULL when that option is unset.

translation.description: The module dict options is used to set the git credentials.
translation.details: options is the stand-in for R's global options. Set options["remotes.git_credentials"] before the call. A missing key is None. The process environment is not read.
translation.value: The value stored under remotes.git_credentials, or None when that key is missing.
translation.example:
from remotes.git_credentials import git_credentials, options
options["remotes.git_credentials"] = "plain-token"
git_credentials()
